reason: Describe the guarded updater refusal when no deployment selector is configured. Only update_and_restart description text changes; preserve all earlier compatibility evidence.

update_and_restart.previous_description: Update and restart the daemon. Without deploy.tag_glob or deploy.track_branch, pull the upstream and restart even when already current. With a release or branch selector, run shared preflight and launch the operator updater; returns pid, log, selector and commit, or up_to_date without restarting. Read the log for the final outcome. Use wait_for_tasks=true to let running tasks finish before restarting; scheduling resumes if the updater exits without restarting. Excluded from MCP by default for safety.
update_and_restart.description: Update and restart the daemon. Requires deploy.tag_glob or deploy.track_branch; otherwise refuses with operator configuration guidance. Run shared preflight and launch the operator updater; returns pid, log, selector and commit, or up_to_date without restarting. Read the log for the final outcome. Use wait_for_tasks=true to let running tasks finish before restarting; scheduling resumes if the updater exits without restarting. Excluded from MCP by default for safety.
